title: Editorial authority · subtly Nick
question: This hand follows your steer: Zack-like density and confidence, without copying his visual identity. Every option includes intentional light and dark themes.

options.label: The Working Index
options.lineage: technical journals · studio indexes · living bodies of work
options.thesis: A dense editorial index makes Nick’s writing, systems, talks, and workshops feel like one continuously evolving practice.
options.viewport: A confident AI-native DX thesis and portrait lead immediately into a living index of current work; Workshops is the primary numbered destination, while writing and talks begin in the first fold.
options.risk: Closest to the quality you like in Zack’s site, so originality must come from Nick’s purple/teal system, voice, portraiture, and a different index grammar rather than copied section numbering.
options.case: Best balance: Zack-like authority and density, but grounded in Nick’s own archive and identity. Light reads as a technical journal; dark reads as the same publication after hours.

options.label: The Bitmap Journal
options.lineage: Emigre specimens · early digital publishing · modern engineering journals
options.thesis: Visible pixels in the display type connect Nick’s web-tooling history to the AI-native present without turning the page into a terminal.
options.case: More distinctive than Zack while retaining editorial density; strongest if the bitmap voice stays in headlines and indexing, never body copy.
options.viewport: A poster-scale pixel headline meets a crisp portrait and compact role proof; a specimen-like index previews workshops, current writing, and talks at multiple scales.
options.risk: Can feel retro or overly designed if pixels spread into controls and prose; both themes must keep long-form reading quiet.

options.label: The Field Edition
options.lineage: expedition newspapers · technical field reports · issue-based publishing
options.thesis: Nick’s site reads like a field edition produced from the front of a fast-moving engineering practice.
options.case: Carries a strong authored voice and body-of-work feeling; less visually adjacent to Zack, but equally confident and editorial.
options.viewport: A modern masthead, large thesis, current issue note, and portrait establish Nick; Workshops appears as the lead field assignment with recent dispatches beginning below.
options.risk: Could become faux-vintage or newspaper cosplay; use contemporary type, cool neutrals, and clean digital behavior rather than distressed effects.

options.label: The Instrument Editorial
options.lineage: night-flight instruments · editorial dashboards · practiced cross-checks
options.thesis: A calm editorial surface lets technical leaders cross-check the few signals that establish Nick’s authority.
options.case: Most technical and strongest dark theme; the instrument detail stays subtle around an otherwise editorial page.
options.viewport: A human portrait and thesis dominate; three quiet signal readouts show current role, years of practice, and teaching evidence, then lead into Workshops and the archive.
options.risk: Could resemble a dashboard or rely on invented metrics; every signal must be a verified fact and the editorial story must remain primary.

canonCard.label: Zack-adjacent canon
canonCard.thesis: A dense, polished personal editorial site with numbered sections, abundant proof, and dark/light themes.
canonCard.viewport: Personal thesis and current role above writing, workshops, speaking, and a compact proof ledger.
canonCard.risk: It directly answers the reference but offers the least separation from Zack; choose only if familiarity matters more than a new authored system.
